title: Truly: a privacy-first music recommender
description:
Truly is a free, open source, privacy-first music recommender. A listener describes their mood and energy, and Truly plays a short path of classical music that starts where they are and moves one piece at a time towards calmer or brighter, with a reason for every piece.

Optional camera and voice inputs run on the listener's device with small models distilled from LAION's Empathic-Insight models, and only nudge where a path starts. Code is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later; the Truly face and voice model weights are licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Truly is not designed or intended for medical, diagnostic, psychological assessment, therapeutic or clinical purposes.
